bible_verses.english: “You are worthy, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power; for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed and were created!”
For great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.
He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, You alone are holy, mighty, and worthy of all my praise. Thank You for inviting me into Your presence and calling me to follow You each day. Give me a heart that eagerly listens to Your voice and a spirit ready to walk in Your ways. I choose to love You today with all my strength and to honor You in everything I do. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Worship begins when we lift our eyes to see who God truly is—holy, mighty, and infinitely worthy of our highest praise. As we declare His majesty together, our hearts are naturally moved from awe to active devotion. Acknowledging His holiness invites us into a deeper commitment to follow His voice, listen to His guidance, and love Him with all that we are. May this song remind you that praising the Lord is not just a melody we sing, but a daily walk of loving obedience.
